current_evidence: Not verified live: the web-fetch budget for this session ran out before any Guildford page could be loaded. The candidate is the council's own 'The Local Validation List' page (article 22693), which appears in Grokbot's docs_read, while the workbook link is only the application-type page for removal or variation of a condition (s73).

issues.detail: The 'Validation list URL' and 'Planning page' both point to the single application-type page for 'Removal or variation of a condition following grant of planning permission or Listed Building Consent' (s73). That is not the council's local validation list. Guildford publishes a hub page, 'The Local Validation List' (article 22693), which Grokbot itself read according to docs_read. That hub should be the reference link.
issues.evidence: workbook URL slug '/article/22712/Removal-or-variation-of-a-condition...' compared with docs_read entry '/article/22693/The-Local-Validation-List'

issues.detail: Householder is shown as '(none)', yet Grokbot's own tab items from the householder page (article 22710, 'Planning permission for works or extension to a dwelling') list local requirements: existing and proposed elevations, floor plans, roof plans (if needed), key dimensions of all new works, and a scale bar. Those items were instead placed under Full planning as 'Floor plans / Elevations' and 'Roof plan', with the note 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning'. The cited source is the householder page.

'Ventilation / Extraction details' is placed under 'Change of use - prior approval', but its source is the 'Full planning permission (change of use only)' page. That is a full planning application for change of use, not a prior approval.

Local requirements that Grokbot captured in tab_items are not carried into the application-type rows. Advertisement consent is '(none)', although the advert page lists size, siting, materials, extent of projection, lighting details, existing and proposed elevations, and key dimensions of the advertisement(s). Outline and Reserved matters are '(none)', although tab items from those pages require key dimensions and a scale bar. The change-of-use page's 'existing and proposed site sections' and 'finished floor and site levels' do not appear in any row.

Under Works to trees, 'Arboricultural Impact Assessment / Tree Survey' and 'Photographs / Photomontages' are listed as requirements. The source text says these are optional items that make acceptance more likely. Only details of replacement trees are required, and only when trees are to be felled.
issues.evidence: "However, we may be more likely to accept your application if you include the following: annotated photographs... a report by a tree professional... details of replacement trees (this is only a requirement if you want to cut trees down)"

issues.detail: Several tab items start with navigation text ('Check the national requirements on the Planning Portal (opens new window) Local requirements...'). The tree items are cut off mid-word ('...if you want to cut t').

The same scale-bar sentence and the same 'key dimensions of all new works' sentence appear several times from different pages. 'Floor plans / Elevations' and 'Roof plan' are two rows made from one sentence.

The extraction is partial: Grokbot read 17 pages but captured only 8 items. Listed building consent, Demolition in conservation area, Lawful development certificate and s73 all show '(none)', even though docs_read includes the Full planning + LBC page, the householder + LBC page, the demolition-in-conservation-area pages, the LDC page and the s73 page. These need re-extraction from the hub list. The list date was not captured ('Undated'). Neither could be checked against the live source in this run.

summary: Grokbot's link is one application-type page (s73), not Guildford's 'The Local Validation List' hub (article 22693), and its own extracted items are attached to the wrong application types (householder items filed under Full planning, change-of-use items under prior approval) or are optional tree items treated as required. The live source could not be checked: the shared web-fetch budget ran out, so the contents and date need a follow-up check.
